runs.context: Diagnostic attempts before final native attestation; no usable aggregate latency measurement from these attempts.

observations.outcome: Embedded WebDriver port did not become ready within 60 seconds.
Tauri global API was unavailable in the window; attempt interrupted.
Tauri global API remained unavailable; attempt interrupted. Left a stale app which contaminated the first preview attempt.
Connected to the stale prior test app. Its removed fixture caused an error; writing to its closed stderr pipe aborted that stale process. No timings accepted.
execute/async timed out after about 120 seconds; the callback initially included a nested helper and did not wait for workspace restoration between entries.
11 complete repetitions, then native paint callbacks suspended for 15 seconds although the diff was present. No aggregate timings emitted; failed observation retained.
Callback stalled for 15 seconds while diff content was present. Test-only WebKit background throttling was subsequently disabled.
